name: Giant Eagle
languages: understands Common and Primordial (Auran) but can't speak them

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The eagle makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Radiant damage.

description: Giant eagles are noble, intelligent birds of prey that nest on remote mountaintops, sometimes allying with good-hearted travelers against the forces of evil.
